propositions: An O_EXCL enrich-drain.lock created without owner stamp persists permanently as a 0-byte file when the drainer process dies, causing all subsequent drain attempts to skip with FileExistsError and log INFO instead of failing, wedging enrichment invisibly.
The drain lock lacks any staleness adjudication, pid-liveness check, or reclamation path, unlike the store's mkdir write lock which has ownership discipline and stale-lock recovery.

A leaked unstamped lock file older than the ceiling threshold (1h) must become reclaimable, but a fresh unstamped lock (< ceiling age) must be respected to avoid breaking the acquire/stamp write window.

Upon FileExistsError during lock acquire, the code must extract and parse the owner stamp, determine staleness using the shared stale-lock core with unrecognised_via_ceiling=True, and reclaim the lock with a bounded single retry if stale, logging WARNING with holder and age.
